title: "Stop Following Pastors Who Preach Themselves Instead of Jesus!" 🔥
paragraphs: "Stop Following Pastors Who Preach Themselves Instead of Jesus!" 🔥

🔥 MANY CHURCHES TODAY LOOK HOLY… BUT JESUS ISN’T IN THEM!
🚨 Preachers are getting rich while their congregations stay spiritually poor.
🚨 Pastors are building brands, not disciples.
🚨 Sermons are full of self-help, but empty of repentance and holiness.
📖 "For the time will come when people will not endure sound teaching, but will gather for themselves teachers who say what they want to hear." (2 Timothy 4:3)
😨 Many pastors are leading people to themselves—not to JESUS.
🚨 ARE YOU FOLLOWING A MAN OR FOLLOWING CHRIST?

🔥 1. A TRUE PASTOR PREACHES JESUS—NOT THEMSELVES!
📖 "We do not preach ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord." (2 Corinthians 4:5)
🚨 Signs you’re following a FALSE TEACHER:

❌ They talk more about themselves than about Jesus.
❌ They make you feel good, but never call you to repent.
❌ They promise blessings, but never warn about judgment.
❌ They seek fame, money, and power over truth.
❌ They twist Scripture to fit their agenda.
🔥 If a pastor isn’t leading you to Jesus, HE IS LEADING YOU ASTRAY!
📖 "If the blind lead the blind, both will fall into a pit." (Matthew 15:14)
🚨 IS YOUR PASTOR LEADING YOU CLOSER TO JESUS OR TO THEMSELVES?

🔥 2. SATAN LOVES FALSE TEACHERS WHO PREACH A "SAFE" GOSPEL
📖 "Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light." (2 Corinthians 11:14)

🚨 SATAN’S FAVORITE KIND OF PREACHER?
💰 The one who only talks about money.
🏆 The one who makes Christianity all about success.
🤡 The one who entertains people instead of convicting them.
🛑 The one who NEVER preaches on sin, hell, or repentance.
🔥 A watered-down gospel cannot save your soul!
📖 "Woe to you when all people speak well of you, for so their fathers did to the false prophets." (Luke 6:26)
🚨 IF A PREACHER NEVER OFFENDS SINNERS, HE ISN’T PREACHING THE GOSPEL!

🔥 3. HOW TO KNOW IF YOU’RE IN A BIBLICAL CHURCH
📖 "Test everything; hold fast to what is good." (1 Thessalonians 5:21)
🚀 A TRUE CHURCH WILL ALWAYS:

✅ PREACH JESUS CHRIST—not motivational speeches.
📖 "I determined to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified." (1 Corinthians 2:2)

✅ CALL PEOPLE TO REPENTANCE—not just "feeling good."
📖 "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand!" (Matthew 3:2)

✅ TEACH SOUND DOCTRINE—not just popular trends.
📖 "Preach the word; be ready in season and out of season." (2 Timothy 4:2)

✅ WARN ABOUT SIN, HELL, AND JUDGMENT—not just prosperity.
📖 "For the wages of sin is death." (Romans 6:23)
🔥 A TRUE PASTOR LEADS YOU TO THE CROSS—NOT TO THEMSELVES.
🚨 IS YOUR CHURCH PREACHING THE FULL GOSPEL?

🔥 THE BIBLICAL CHURCH CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your church—is it truly preaching JESUS?

🔥 That’s exactly why you SHOULD!

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 23, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father, open my eyes to the truth. If I have been following a watered-down gospel, wake me up! Lead me to a Bible-preaching church that preaches repentance, holiness, and the true message of salvation. Give me discernment to recognize false teachers, and help me to always follow Jesus, not men. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN! 🙏🔥
